ui_inventory.reason: Exactly the four existing game-option onClick predicates are changed; all original button input routes, constraints and callback identities remain. StartOptions adds one parsed type but no new input or observation command.

snapshot_statics.reason: The new policy has no fields; SPDSettings adds only an immutable String configuration key. Desktop defaults are captured in launch-local callbacks, without new model static roots or mutable fields. Runtime manifest tests remain separately required.

policy_and_startup_review.reason: Profile availability reads preserve every original class, victory, subclass, ability and INFO-tier prerequisite when disabled, including the absence of a native debug override for talent tiers. When enabled they only grant entry/preview eligibility, never badges or in-run progression.
Persist unlock_start_options with default false; reading a missing value does not initialize or migrate a profile.
Original isUnlocked delegates to the centralized policy; character initialization, equipment, actions and class mechanics are unchanged.

Capture strict absent-or-empty directory state before launch writes. After lock acquisition and binding loaded preferences, only an empty settings map receives unlock, skip-intro and current-version defaults. Any loaded setting, including an unrelated unflushed key, blocks all defaults. Directory/error/symlink handling is relocated from the existing strict CLI implementation.

GUI captures freshness before acquiring ProfileLock, loads settings inside the lock, binds GameSettings and FileUtils, then applies shared defaults before display setup. The already-locked CLI path uses its supplied callback without recapturing post-audit freshness.
Delegate freshness/shared initialization to the desktop helper and append only existing CLI language/window defaults after the shared loaded-settings guard.
Only change the initialization callback type to receive the loaded Preferences. Existing audit-pair/game identity validation still precedes freshness capture and profile lock/audit writes.

unchanged_rules: Native earned victory congratulations still require the actual VICTORY badge.
Native daily future-date, active daily run and replay checks remain unchanged.
Native seed format and duplicate-existing-random-run protection remain unchanged.
Only INFO talent previews gain tier availability; native actual hero levels, points, subclasses and armor abilities remain unchanged.
No badges, rankings or guidebook progress is granted; no combat, AI, map generation, RNG or run-save implementation changes.
Mobile platforms do not run the desktop initialization helper; the core setting reads false when absent.
